scientific_integrity: Exact exhaustive 4095-mask search and cross-check via 39 geometric orbits, geometric smoothness in four charts, branch-support 2-rank and genus-two zeta coefficients from F4 point counts.
scientific_limitations: Equation-weighted counts for a fixed bihomogeneous coordinate system over F2 only; earlier unindexed tables and indirect classification derivations may predate the result. No larger-field generalization, and no independent scientific audit.
title: Exact p-rank and point-count strata of bidegree \(2,3\) genus-two curves over \(\mathbf F_2\)
